record_title: Residual-volume uniqueness and multiplicity continuity for generic isoperimetry
limitations: The result does not prove uniqueness at every real volume fraction; the exceptional set may be uncountable. The residual-volume and strict-BV continuity statements are structural consequences of very recent generic-uniqueness and compactness theorems, not a new perturbative uniqueness argument. No measure or dimension bound for the exceptional set, smooth dependence, nesting, or boundary regularity improvement is proved. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from the recency of the primary source.
